fields.summary: Autonomous plan of change set 01M6H6S (the daemon pins a full CPU core on the 4-core VM because every 5 s poll re-reads and re-folds the whole log). No owner present. The planner read daemonPoll1, planRead, openCtxWorkspace and inboxOverlaps in internal/api and raised one question to the arbiter: what an idle poll may skip, and how a poll's cost is measured. The arbiter decided (daemon-poll-caches-fold-not-picks): cache only the fold-derived work (plan result, workspace, candidates, change-set lookups) keyed on log, git ref and settings stamps; keep run journals, liveness, clock-based holds, picks and queued work evaluated every poll; the daemon's own writes invalidate the cache; measure with a deterministic fold-count test plus an optional benchmark, no wall-clock threshold. The planner put the change set under milestone 24's on-the-VM intent, as the fault shows on the VM, and planned two leaves under the daemon capability.
fields.title: Daemon CPU fix plan, autonomous run
